instruction: Help me to install Materia theme from gnome-look.org and apply it to my GNOME desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing Materia theme from gnome-look.org and applying it to GNOME desktop. Evaluator checks if gtk-theme setting contains 'Materia' using gsettings command. Similar to original task but with different theme name.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface gtk-theme' to retrieve the currently applied GTK theme in GNOME
The check_list metric with regex pattern 'Materia' correctly verifies if the theme name contains 'Materia' (including variants like Materia-dark, Materia-light)
Evaluator successfully verifies the primary requirement: that the Materia theme has been applied to the GNOME desktop
The pattern matching is appropriately flexible to accept any Materia theme variant, which aligns with the instruction that doesn't specify a particular variant
Postconfig execution flow is correct: command executes, output saved to cache file, getter reads cache file, metric validates content
